answer: Rotation is recorded in the hollow index and the pearl audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the comet beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 325 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 17 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
